author: Nelev
body:
## Summary
- Adds `export_conversation_pdf`, an agent tool that renders the current conversation to a PDF (reportlab) in `medas-api/exports/` and returns the file name. It takes no arguments: the turns come from the run's own state, so the model can only export the conversation it is in.
- Prompt line so the agent calls it on "export this conversation as pdf" instead of searching the record.
- Tool-calling eval: 3 new cases (easy, medium, and an edge case for "email this conversation"), 17 total. Run result: tool 17/17; params 16/17 (one existing search case worded its query without the "allerg" keyword).

## Known gap
The file is only written to the server. There is no download route, so a patient is told a file name they cannot yet fetch, and exports have no cleanup. A user-scoped download route through `controller/` is the follow-up.

## Test plan
- [x] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q` (169 passed)
- [x] `uv run python -m dataset.eval.run_tool_eval`
